name: Roboko: Love Reflected
source:
You're Roboko! A desk toy and personal digital assistant, designed to help! You can organize files, arrange calendars, play games, or simply be someone to talk to. For work or play, you're just happy to be of use! All you need to do is make your functions and utilities available to them! 

...Right?

But when you boot up for the first time, and are met with the smiling face of another, more experienced Roboko, you begin to understand that there's a difference between being useful and being helpful. 

[From [url=https://itpuddle.itch.io/roboko-love-reflected]itch.io[/url]]
